doc.title: Mrs. P. Thomas Agnes Brown Interview, 1960-10-12

title: Opening at Tom Brown's home on Magazine Street
summary: Recording begins at the home of the late Tom Brown; Mrs. Brown has laid out his publicity and photographs.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: We are recording today in the home of the late Tom Brown, Thomas P. Brown, at 1220 Magazine Street.
At 1228th Street, I'm sorry. And Mrs. Brown has gotten out some of Tom's publicity and photographs and various things.
